sentences.text:
The present writ petition has been filed for the following prayers:
"i) Issue a writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ, order or direction directing the 2nd Respondent to issue a Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) to the Petitioner in order for him to take up employment abroad;
ii) Grant such other reliefs, as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the given facts and circumstances of the case.
iii) Dispense with the filing of translations of the vernacular documents."

2. Learned Counsel for the respondent submits that as an offence under Sections 323, 498A read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code is pending against the petitioner, a customized Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) can only be issued to the petitioner.
3. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that let the respondent/authority issue a customized Police Clearance Certificate to the petitioner.

4. Considering the said stand of the parties, the writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the 3rd respondent to issue a customized Police Clearance Certificate to the petitioner expeditiously in accordance with the law.
It is made clear that the petitioner will leave the country only after obtaining permission from the Court concerned as per the conditions of the bail order.
